tint.note: CSS --primary in the dark rendition; text uses --primary-ink oklch(82% 0.095 200deg).

tint-day.note: CSS --primary in the light rendition; text uses --primary-ink oklch(43% 0.085 208deg).

on-tint.note: Night text on the tint; day uses white.

glass-solid.note: Opaque fallback for glass; the live glass is oklch(23% 0.01 250deg / 64%) at night, oklch(98.6% 0.003 250deg / 70%) by day; day fallback oklch(97.6% 0.004 250deg).

memory.note: Lightness fixed; only opacity (0.16-1.0) encodes R.

memory-day.note: Lightness fixed; only opacity encodes R.

bar.note: CSS --bar in the dark rendition; neutral bars of the 7-day forecast and the 30-day chart. Today's bar uses the tint.

bar-weak.note: Weekend bars in the 30-day chart; day value oklch(65% 0.012 250deg), lighter than --bar.

title.purpose: The question on the review card; 22px at <=760px.

headline.purpose: The answer under the reveal line; 17px at <=760px.

toolbar-title.purpose: Page name in the sticky glass toolbar.

body.purpose: Explanations and summaries; section heads at 650.

shadows.purpose: Selected segment of a segmented control.

components.name: Reveal Button
components.description: Primary action of the question phase, in the tint, with its Space keycap.
components.css: .ds-reveal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 260px; height: 46px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 600 15.5px/1 var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s var(--ease-out), transform 0.18s var(--ease-out); } .ds-reveal:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 88%, var(--ink)); } .ds-reveal:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-reveal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-kbd { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid currentcolor; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Rating Button
components.description: One of four ratings: weak hue fill, ink text, keycap, label and interval; suggested gets an inset ring.
components.css: .ds-ratings { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; } .ds-rate { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 3px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; text-align: left; font: 600 15px/1.3 var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s var(--ease-out), transform 0.18s var(--ease-out); } .ds-again { background: var(--red-weak); color: var(--red-ink); } .ds-good { background: var(--green-weak); color: var(--green-ink); } .ds-rate:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, currentcolor 22%, transparent); } .ds-rate:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-rate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-suggested { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px currentcolor; } .ds-rate-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-rkbd { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; border: 1px solid currentcolor; border-radius: 6px; font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); opacity: 0.7; } .ds-iv { padding-left: 28px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.85; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Confidence Segmented Control
components.description: Rounded-rectangle track with raised selected segment; confidence 1-3 before reveal.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fill); } .ds-seg button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--body); font: 600 13.5px/1.2 var(--font); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.18s var(--ease-out), color 0.18s var(--ease-out); } .ds-seg button:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-seg .ds-on { background: var(--seg-on); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: var(--shadow-raised); } .ds-skbd { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0 4px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px; font: 600 10.5px/1 var(--mono); color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Decision Tray
components.description: Glass panel pinned to the bottom of the review column holding the whole decision; opaque under reduced transparency.
components.html: How sure are you?
components.css: .ds-tray { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 12px 12px 12px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge); border-radius: 24px; background: var(--glass); backdrop-filter: var(--blur); -webkit-backdrop-filter: var(--blur); box-shadow: var(--shadow); } .ds-tray-label { font: 400 13.5px/1.4 var(--font); color: var(--muted); } .ds-tray-btn { margin-left: auto; height: 46px; min-width: 200px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--on-primary); font: 600 15.5px/1 var(--font); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tray-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 88%, var(--ink)); } .ds-tray-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce) { .ds-tray { background: var(--glass-solid); backdrop-filter: none; } }

components.name: Inset-Grouped List
components.description: iOS inset-grouped list, the library's container and the inspector's: muted 13px header, opaque hairline-bordered 16px group, hairline-divided rows with tabular values, optional muted footer.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-group-h { margin: 0 0 7px; padding: 0 14px; font: 500 13px/1.4 var(--font); color: var(--muted); } .ds-group { margin: 0; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 10px 14px; border: 0; background: transparent; font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font); text-align: left; color: var(--body); } .ds-row + .ds-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-row dd { margin: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-action { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action:hover { background: var(--fill); } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-rdot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--memory); opacity: var(--r, 1); }

components.name: Memory Field
components.description: Signature: the session's cards as solid points whose opacity is R; current card ringed in the tint, new cards outlined.
components.css: .ds-memfield { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 22px); gap: 4px; padding: 14px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; width: max-content; } .ds-pt { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-pt::before { content: ''; width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--memory); opacity: var(--r, 1); transition: opacity 0.9s var(--ease-out); } .ds-pt.ds-new::before { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--memory); opacity: 0.55; } .ds-pt.ds-cur { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-pt:hover::before { opacity: 1; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pt::before { transition: none; } }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill with translucent neutral fill for card type and metadata.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill); color: var(--body); font: 550 12.5px/1.5 var(--font); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--fill-strong); }

components.name: Topic Row
components.description: One topic in a grouped list: title over muted domain · language, a strip of small memory points (one per card), due today, chevron.
components.html: Event loopProgramming · EN3
components.css: .ds-tgroup { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-trow { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto 104px 16px; gap: 10px 20px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 14px; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; font: 400 15px/1.4 var(--font); transition: background 0.18s var(--ease-out); } .ds-trow:hover { background: var(--fill); } .ds-trow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-trow b { display: block; font-weight: 600; } .ds-trow small { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-trow svg { color: var(--muted); } .ds-strip { display: flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-strip i { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-strip i::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--memory); opacity: var(--r, 1); } .ds-strip i.new::before { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--memory); opacity: 0.55; } .ds-due { color: var(--body); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: iOS switch drawn in CSS on a native checkbox with role=switch: fill track, tint when on, white thumb with --thumb-shadow.
components.css: .ds-srow { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 16px; font: 400 15px/1.4 var(--font); color: var(--ink); } .ds-switch { appearance: none; position: relative; flex: none; width: 46px; height: 28px; margin: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill-strong); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-switch::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(100% 0 0deg); box-shadow: var(--thumb-shadow); transition: transform 0.25s var(--ease-out); } .ds-switch:checked { background: var(--primary); } .ds-switch:checked::before { transform: translateX(18px); } .ds-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stepper
components.description: iOS stepper: two 34px buttons around a tabular value on the neutral fill.
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--fill); } .ds-stepper button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 28px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 500 17px/1 var(--font); cursor: pointer; } .ds-stepper button:hover { background: var(--fill-strong); } .ds-stepper button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-stepper output { min-width: 32px; font: 600 15px/1 var(--font); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; color: var(--ink); }

narrative.overview:
A native-feeling study app in the iOS and macOS grammar: system type, tinted near-black grounds, grouped surfaces lifted by lightness, one teal tint, and frosted glass only on chrome that content scrolls beneath. The usual session is in the evening in a dim room, so dark is the primary rendition; light is a complete second rendition. Both follow the OS until the user picks one, and an explicit pick wins either way.

What the user reads (question, answer, diagram, inspector facts) sits on opaque surfaces. The signature move is **memory luminance**: retrievability (R) is the opacity of a solid point in a fixed per-theme color (warm white at night, ink by day). In Review the inspector shows the current session's cards as a field of points, the current one ringed in the tint; a just-rated card's point eases to its new value, and it always brightens: right after a review R is 1 whatever the rating, which only changes stability. The point recurs on every screen: a topic row carries a strip of small points, one per card; the Cards table, the topic's card list and the card inspector show R as a point plus its percent.

Rejected by the user: anything that reads as a SaaS dashboard, a game, or Anki.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, light equally finished; theme follows the OS unless chosen.
Library screens are iOS inset-grouped lists; glass only on the sticky toolbar, decision tray, mobile tab bar and toast.
One teal tint for "you are here", focus and the primary action.
Memory luminance: R as the opacity of a solid point, never a glow.

rules.name: The One Tint Rule
rules.body: The tint marks where the user is and what they do next. If two unrelated things on screen wear it, one is wrong.

rules.name: The No Red Debt Rule
rules.body: Red belongs to the Again rating and destructive actions. Due counts, backlog and missed days never turn red; the after-a-break mode has no color signal at all, its return plan reads from the text.

rules.name: The Rating Hues Stay Ratings Rule
rules.body: The four rating hues mean ratings only. Language and domain chips are neutral.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number (session count, minutes left, timer, intervals, R, badges) uses tabular figures, so it changes in place without reflow.

rules.name: The Glass Floats Rule
rules.body: Glass exists only where real content passes beneath it. Never glass on content, never glass on glass, never a decorative gradient behind glass to make the blur visible.

dos: Do keep reading content on opaque surfaces and reserve glass for the toolbar, decision tray, mobile tab bar and toast.
Do draw retrievability as memory luminance: a solid point whose opacity carries R.
Do give both themes full craft and let diagrams take their colors from tokens.
Do honor reduced transparency and reduced motion with opaque fallbacks and no animation.
Do pair every rating hue with its number key, label and interval.
donts: Don't ship a SaaS dashboard look: no indigo on slate, no grids of KPI tiles, no shadowed content cards.
Don't gamify: no confetti, mascots, streak flames, trophies or celebratory color.
Don't fall back to Anki-style utility: grey tables and raw form controls as the main surface.
Don't use glows, halos or blurred color blobs; luminance is a solid point, not light bleed.
Don't costume iOS on the desktop: no fake status bar, home indicator or device frame.
